title: Collaborating Agents
unsupported: This Runtime does not support collaborating Agents. Upgrade its image.
forbidden: Administrator access and a valid Runtime credential are required.
conflict: Configuration changed. Refresh before editing again.
invalid: Invalid configuration. Check the URL, authentication and credential.
failed: Request failed. Check the Runtime connection and refresh to retry.
checkFailed: Connection check failed. Check the configuration and retry.
discoveryOnly: Discovery verified. Task execution has not been verified.
removeConfirm: Remove this registration? The target Agent will not be deleted.
name: Name
secretHelp: Enter the target Agent token or API key. Saved credentials are never displayed.

reasons.credential_unavailable: Credential unavailable. Edit and enter it again.
reasons.destination_not_allowed: Destination blocked. Private destinations require MPA_COLLABORATOR_PRIVATE_ORIGINS.
reasons.destination_unreachable: Destination unreachable. Check DNS, network and TLS.
reasons.connection_timeout: Connection timed out. Check the service and retry.
reasons.remote_auth_rejected: Authentication rejected. Check credentials and permissions.
reasons.remote_card_http_error: Agent Card request failed. Check its URL and service; redirects are not supported.
reasons.card_too_large: Agent Card exceeds the size limit.
reasons.invalid_agent_card: Response is not a valid A2A Agent Card.
reasons.card_endpoint_origin_mismatch: Agent Card endpoint must share the configured origin.
reasons.unsupported_card_authentication: Configured authentication does not satisfy the Agent Card.
reasons.credential_reflected_in_card: Agent Card reflected a credential and was rejected.
reasons.credential_store_unavailable: Credential storage unavailable. Ask an administrator to check the database and encryption key.

missing: This registration was removed. Refresh the list.
uncertain: Operation outcome is uncertain. Refresh to reconcile before making another change.
savedSecretHelp: A credential is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it.
enabledHelp: Allow this MPA to dispatch tasks to this Agent; disabling retains configuration.
